messages.subject: Tracking Javascript onChange event
parts:
Hi, 

I have a textBox added in RenderUI as follows:

textInput("txtScenario", "No of Scenario you want to add:", value = "3")

My question is, is it possible to track the change of values in the above textbox in javascript code? How can I refer it?
I tried,
$(document).on("change", "text.inputText", function(evt) {

But it is not working.

Thanks a lot,
Dipika

messages.author: c6ca7877bef91eef
messages.subject: Re: Tracking Javascript onChange event
parts:
You can refer to it using its id `txtScenario`. So your code would become

$(document).on("change", "#txtScenario", function(evt){

})

I am not sure if this is idiomatic JS, so there might be ways to make it more efficient.
